item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Managed Redis agent kit
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis agent kit is now in public preview. It adds Redis-specific guidance for building and operating production-ready Redis applications directly into AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IP filtering in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis now supports firewall rules for data access in public preview. You can restrict cache connections by approved source IP addresses or Azure service tags.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Redis 8 in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Redis 8 is in public preview for Azure Managed Redis. The update adds richer queries, atomic JSON updates, field-level expiration, and finer-grained security.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Shard-level metrics in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis public preview now includes shard-level metrics. The new per-shard visibility helps assess workload distribution, detect hotspots, and troubleshoot performance issues.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cache for Redis to Azure Managed Redis migration tooling
item.description:
Azure has generally available built-in DNS migration tooling for moving endpoints from Azure Cache for Redis Basic, Standard, and Premium tiers to Azure Managed Redis. It redirects the existing cache hostname to an Azure Managed Redis endpoint to simplify migration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Managed Redis database integration guidance
item.description:
Azure has launched generally available guidance for integrating Azure Managed Redis with Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL. The update provides caching guidance, reference architectures, and related materials for application integration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Managed Redis keyspace notifications
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis keyspace notifications are now generally available. Applications can subscribe to pub/sub events for selected cache data changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates
